evidence: We are making appreciable investments in deploying artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance effectiveness and create efficiency.
We continue to invest in advanced technologies, including AI, to enhance operational efficiency, improve member experience, and support clinical functions.

Our business is dependent on effective and secure information systems, cloud providers and AI capabilities that assist our personnel in processing provider claims, monitoring utilization and other cost factors, supporting our medical management techniques.

These technologies are increasingly integrated into our information systems and digital platforms to automate administrative processes, streamline claims adjudication, and personalize member experience.
ai_positioning.summary: MOH intègre l'IA en interne pour optimiser ses opérations administratives, la gestion des sinistres et l'efficacité médicale, tout en reconnaissant les risques cybersécurité associés à cette intégration.
